description: One length-framed portable request. Captures must be collected under the original authorization; this checker does not authenticate collection receipts or open their locators.

path_flavor.description: Logical namespace for grants/claims; no physical filesystem claim.

spec_path.description: Original authorized locator used solely as a logical binding.

spec_bytes_base64.description: Canonical base64 of original exact TaskSpec bytes, not reconstructed JSON or an unchecked digest.

authority.description: Opaque transport member immediately validated against the separate closed delegation-authority schema before any use.

captures.description: Only required authorized file-source/resource captures, with original bytes; every declared required capture must be present.

items.description: Caller-supplied original bytes with a logical path; no implicit read permission.

bytes_base64.description: Canonical base64 raw captured bytes; empty captures use an empty string.

runtime_lock_bytes_base64.description: Canonical base64 of exact reviewed lock bytes, bound to independent authority lock_sha256.

capture_receipt_refs.description: References to actual authorized capture records; origin must be verified outside this data checker.

items.description: Reference only; no external retrieval by checker.
